svg.title: Departments a site admin defines — SoftTrack web design mockup (#123)
svg.desc: Settings → Administration gains Departments: a flat list a site admin creates, renames and deletes. Deleting a department with people in it requires choosing where they go.
svg.text: · a row, not free text: created once, picked by everyone

g.text: The names people pick from, set here once. Renaming one renames it for
everyone in it; everyone signed in can read the list.
at once, which is the point of it

svg.text: Deleting a department with people in it
the same shape as deleting a status

g.text: 6 people are in it. Choose where they go; nobody is moved until
A required choice, never a silent

svg.text: Names are unique, whatever the case
and an empty department just goes

g.text: “Engineering” already exists. Department names are unique,

svg.text: A department table (id, name unique case-insensitively, optional description) and a nullable department_id on the profile. Site-admin CRUD lives under Settings → Administration;
the list endpoint is open to anyone signed in, because the directory filter (#125) needs it. People are assigned from the admin user directory (#122).
